guessing endpoints, fields or types. Start here, then open only the file for the area
you work on. The raw specs in `specs/` are complete and can be queried with `jq`, e.g.

## Authentication

- `Bearer` — `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (JWT). neurokaraoke.com session token (the `authToken` value in local storage).
- `GuestId` — header `X-Guest-Id`. Any UUID. Identifies a guest session for game endpoints. Reuse the same value to keep progress across requests.

In the tables, "optional" means the endpoint works without auth but returns more
(for example the caller's own data) when authenticated.

## Reading the types

- `int` is a 32-bit integer, `int64` 64-bit; `double` and `float` are floating point; `number`
  has no format in the spec.
- `date-time` is an ISO 8601 timestamp, `date-span` a duration (spec format `date-span`),
  `base64` Base64-encoded bytes (format `byte`), `binary` a file upload.
- `| null` means the value can be null. `name?:` means the field isn't required; this only
  appears where the spec lists required fields, otherwise every field is shown without `?`.
- `[key: string]: T` means the object allows extra keys. REST request and response objects
  without it are closed in the spec (`additionalProperties: false`) or don't say; check
  `specs/` when it matters.
- `// …` comments carry the spec's description plus defaults, min/max, length limits, regex
  patterns and read-only flags.
- ``{ …same as `x` above }`` repeats the shape of field `x` shown earlier for the same endpoint.

## About the Neuro & Evil Karaoke API

The API behind the Neuro & Evil Karaoke web player at [neurokaraoke.com](https://neurokaraoke.com),
[evilkaraoke.com](https://evilkaraoke.com) and [twinskaraoke.com](https://twinskaraoke.com). 

**Base URL:** `https://api.neurokaraoke.com`

### Authentication

Most read endpoints are public. Endpoints marked with a lock need credentials, passed in one of
these ways:

| Method | Example |
| --- | --- |
| Bearer token **recommended** | `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN` |
| Guest ID | `X-Guest-Id: ANY_UUID` |

The karaoke site lets visitors who are not signed in add songs to playlists, play games and more.
Those requests are tied to a guest ID instead of an account. Send the same UUID every time to keep
the guest's data.

To get a token, sign in with one of the endpoints under **Authentication**, or copy the
`authToken` value from the karaoke site's local storage. Paste it into the authentication panel
without the `Bearer ` prefix. This page fills in a guest ID for you.

### Status codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `200` / `204` | Success |
| `400` | The request is missing a value or has an invalid one |
| `401` | Missing, invalid or expired token |
| `404` | The item does not exist |
| `429` | Too many requests. Wait a moment before trying again |

### Webhooks

Get notified when a karaoke setlist is added or updated.

### Other documents

Listen along and radio chat use WebSockets, and the 24/7 radio runs on AzuraCast. Each has its own
document. Pick them from the document selector at the top of the sidebar.

## Listen along (WebSocket) — messages

| Direction | Message | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| send | [`Ping`](listen-along.md) | Keepalive request. |
| send | [`Play`](listen-along.md) | Resume playback. |
| send | [`Pause`](listen-along.md) | Pause playback. |
| send | [`Seek`](listen-along.md) | Seek within the current song. |
| send | [`SkipNext`](listen-along.md) | Advance to the next song in the queue. |
| send | [`SkipPrevious`](listen-along.md) | Restart the current song, or move to the previous song if playback is near the start. |
| send | [`PlaySongAt`](listen-along.md) | Start playback at a specific queue item. |
| send | [`ReportPosition`](listen-along.md) | Host playback heartbeat, sent every few seconds to keep listeners synchronized. |
| send | [`AddSong`](listen-along.md) | Appends a song to the queue. Ignored if the song is already queued, unless duplicates are allowed. |
| send | [`RemoveSong`](listen-along.md) | Removes a song from the queue. |
| send | [`ReorderQueue`](listen-along.md) | Moves a queue item to a new position. |
| send | [`ShuffleQueue`](listen-along.md) | Shuffles the remaining queue items. |
| send | [`SetRepeatMode`](listen-along.md) | Sets the repeat mode. |
| send | [`ListenerAddSong`](listen-along.md) | AddSong variant for listeners. Requires the room's listener-add permission and is subject to the room's cooldown. |
| send | [`SendMessage`](listen-along.md) | Sends a chat message (max 500 characters). The payload is either a string or an object with `content` and an optional `replyToId`. |
| send | [`KickUser`](listen-along.md) | Removes a user from the room. |
| send | [`CloseRoom`](listen-along.md) | Closes the room and disconnects all users. |
| receive | [`Pong`](listen-along.md) | Keepalive response. |
| receive | [`RoomState`](listen-along.md) | Full room snapshot, sent once immediately after connecting. |
| receive | [`PlaybackSync`](listen-along.md) | Current song and playback position. Sent after every playback change and periodically during playback. |
| receive | [`QueueUpdated`](listen-along.md) | Full queue, sent on every change. Replaces the client's copy. |
| receive | [`RepeatModeChanged`](listen-along.md) | Repeat mode changed. |
| receive | [`ListenerJoined`](listen-along.md) | A user joined the room. |
| receive | [`ListenerLeft`](listen-along.md) | A user left the room. |
| receive | [`ListenerCount`](listen-along.md) | Current number of connections in the room. |
| receive | [`CoHostsUpdated`](listen-along.md) | Co-host list changed. |
| receive | [`RoomSettingsUpdated`](listen-along.md) | Room settings changed (name, visibility, listener permissions). |
| receive | [`ReceiveMessage`](listen-along.md) | New chat message. |
| receive | [`ReceiveMessageHistory`](listen-along.md) | Recent chat history, sent on connect. |
| receive | [`MessageDeleted`](listen-along.md) | A chat message was deleted. |
| receive | [`SongSuggestion`](listen-along.md) | Song results from the room bot in response to chat commands such as search or recommend. |
| receive | [`Kicked`](listen-along.md) | Sent to a user who was removed. The connection closes immediately afterwards. |
| receive | [`RoomClosed`](listen-along.md) | The room was closed. All connections are terminated. |
| receive | [`Error`](listen-along.md) | The previous client message was rejected. |

## Radio chat (WebSocket) — messages

| Direction | Message | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| send | [`Ping`](radio-chat.md) | Keepalive request. |
| send | [`SendMessage`](radio-chat.md) | Sends a chat message (max 300 characters). The payload is either a string or an object with `content` and an optional `replyToId`. |
| send | [`DeleteMessage`](radio-chat.md) | Deletes one of the caller's messages. Returns an Error if the caller does not own the message. |
| send | [`LoadMoreHistory`](radio-chat.md) | Requests older messages. The payload is the number of messages the client already has. The server returns up to 50 messages preceding them. |
| receive | [`Pong`](radio-chat.md) | Keepalive response. |
| receive | [`ReceiveMessageHistory`](radio-chat.md) | The 50 most recent messages, sent on connect. |
| receive | [`MoreMessageHistory`](radio-chat.md) | Response to LoadMoreHistory. |
| receive | [`ReceiveMessage`](radio-chat.md) | New chat message, including the caller's own. |
| receive | [`MessageDeleted`](radio-chat.md) | A message was deleted by its author, a moderator or automated moderation. |
| receive | [`MessagesPurged`](radio-chat.md) | All messages were purged. Clients should clear their message list. |
| receive | [`UserTimedOut`](radio-chat.md) | A user was timed out. Messages from that user are rejected until the timeout expires. |
| receive | [`UserCount`](radio-chat.md) | Current number of connections in the room. |
| receive | [`NowPlayingChanged`](radio-chat.md) | The radio started a new song. Same payload as `GET /nowplaying`. Also sent once on connect. |
| receive | [`Error`](radio-chat.md) | The previous client message was rejected (for example, deleting another user's message). |
